committee: *Presentation of Certificate No. 303-38 (COR) - Senator Tina Rose Muña-Barnes
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Please join me in presenting, Certificate No. 303-38 (LS) - Tina Rose Muña-Barnes – presented to the visiting cultural group from South Korea for supporting and contributing to the 6th Youth K-Pop Dance Contest; and to commend them for their dedication to promoting and celebrating the cultures of Guam and the Republic of Korea during the Korean Cultural New Year 2026. Presentation will take place on Saturday, February 14 at 3pm at Micronesia Mall. Si Yu’os Ma’åse’! 2/13/2026 11:32 A.M. (FN)
